support_criterion: For this visual architectural model, each solid hip seat must contact the underlying roof and the round ridge over a finite central support band in the actual serialized mesh. Full contact under the entire cap width is not required where the cap intentionally overhangs a narrower tapered seat.
rationale: Root read the actual exported triangle reports and ridge_seat/tube construction: the 45mm-radius round ridge sits on a tapered crest whose width is narrower than the cap. All36hips×7sections×5offsets(-10,-5,0,+5,+10mm),1260 actual tests, have positive solid interval overlap; the reported minima are19.146mm roof-to-seat and21.845mm seat-to-ridge. Thus the existing centerline evidence is strengthened to sampled finite-width support. The400 gaps at±25mm and72 endpoint rays outside the seat/roof footprint remain recorded; they do not imply that the whole ridge floats. Original full-width criterion/result are not altered. Door,porch and open-hoop tests remain separate actual positive evidence.
limitations: This accepts a finite geometry contact criterion only; native visual and browser acceptance are still pending.
Original full-width hip_contact report passed=false and hip_full_width_finite_contact_passed=false are retained and must be disclosed in downstream evidence.
No claim of continuous contact at every point, whole-assembly collision freedom, physically certified load-bearing behavior or surveyed historical support dimensions.
Free decorative ridge tips beyond t=1 remain modeled cantilevers; finite-width tests do not certify all endpoint or lateral surfaces.
